summary: Mistral launched Agentic Search, a multi-step retrieval toolkit (search, open, navigate, read, grep tools) integrated into its Search Toolkit and Libraries, and published benchmark results showing accuracy, latency and token-usage improvements over one-shot RAG on FinanceBench and OfficeQA Pro.

mechanisms.reason: The retrieval technique reduces the number of tokens and latency needed to complete a given task, lowering compute consumed per completed query.
mechanisms.quote: Fewer repeated searches reduce token consumption by up to one-third.

practices.reason: The multi-step retrieval loop with five concrete tools (search, open, navigate, read, grep) is a described, implementable technique with stated accuracy and efficiency gains.
practices.quote: Agentic Search introduces a multi-step retrieval loop for finding, inspecting, and verifying information across data sources, wherever it is stored.

practices.reason: The lab reports detailed, reproducible benchmark results (FinanceBench, OfficeQA Pro) that an engineering team could use to measure their own retrieval system.
practices.quote: Agentic Search delivers to 3x correctness on financial filings, from 26.7% to 86%, based on FinanceBench.

practices.reason: Targeted navigation is shown to cut latency and token consumption on the same infrastructure, a technique reproducible on the vendor's own stack.
practices.quote: Targeted navigation enables Agentic Search to reduce p90 latency up to 39.6% .
